what: Dark-music firmware for the FM-1: 21 genres, 210 pieces, from dark techno to dark ambient and darkwave. Wander evolves it on its own. Arp with Hold, Dice, step editor. New visuals, simpler settings, bigger text, plain-language help, SEL shortcut menu. 1.0.6: Advanced mode nowshows every page.
author: Polystellarflow
